name: Elise Shelley
source: Proletariat life isn’t easy, but Elise always tries to be brave and maintains a positive attitude. As she labors from dawn to dusk in a factory, however, she thinks about the seemingly inescapable future that will throw her into a life of disgrace. What a harsh world for a young girl who really just wants to play the piano.
